about_short_description.short_description: Optasia is a fintech company that develops airtime credit and mobile value-added services for mobile operators and financial institutions.

product.name: Micro Lending
product.description: A portfolio of micro and nano lending solutions that can be integrated into partner ecosystems, providing quick and convenient microloans for individuals and small businesses.

product.name: Airtime Advance
product.description: Flexible airtime, data, and package credit solutions for mobile network operators, allowing them to offer airtime advances to their customers.

product.name: Data Monetization
product.description: Turn-key product-as-a-service solutions that enable mobile network operators to leverage their data for new revenue streams and enhanced customer engagement.

product.name: T-Score
product.description: A service that builds customer profiles for credit-related services, lead generation, and targeted marketing, ensuring compliance with data protection laws.

product.name: XtraCall
product.description: A call-back service that allows customers with zero or insufficient balance to send a missed call notification to another person.

product.name: BNPL (Buy Now, Pay Later)
product.description: A digital lending product that allows customers to make purchases and pay for them at a later date, enhancing service offerings for financial institutions.
